      "text": "Here is the step-by-step analysis and the tools you need to generate the full report for your team archive.\n\n### 1. Methodology: The \"Weighted Match Cost\"\nSince players used **Freestyle** (picking their own difficulty), a standard Match Cost formula is unfair because it treats a 4* FC the same as a 7* FC.\n\nI have applied your requested formula:\n$$ \\text{Weighted Score} \u003d \\text{Score} \\times \\text{Star Rating} $$\n\n**The Match Cost Formula:**\n1.  **Round Average:** For every map played, we calculate the average *Weighted Score* of the lobby.\n2.  **Player Performance:** We divide the player\u0027s *Weighted Score* by the *Round Average*. (e.g., if you get a 1.5, you performed 50% better than the lobby average).\n3.  **Final Cost:** The average of these performance ratios across all maps played.\n\n---\n\n### 2. Player Performance Evaluation (Preview)\n*Based on the match history provided, here is the evaluation of the most active players. Note that **pakastin** dominated this session significantly.*\n\n| Rank | Player | Maps Played | Avg Acc | Avg Score | Match Cost (Weighted) | Evaluation |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| **1** | **pakastin** | 24 | 94.15% | 12,896,914 (Total) | **1.62** | **MVP.** Consistently picked high SR maps (7-8*) and scored A-ranks, significantly outperforming the lobby average. |\n| **2** | **12811440** | 24 | 94.15% | 537k (Avg) | **1.62** | (Same user as pakastin, listed for data verification). |\n| **3** | **timiimit** | 23 | 81.81% | 336k (Avg) | **1.05** | Solid performance. Played high SR but struggled with consistency (more F/C ranks) compared to the MVP. |\n| **4** | **wuyiomokunrin** | 27 | 92.96% | 472k (Avg) | **1.02** | Very consistent. Reliable average performance relative to the room. |\n| **5** | **Slare_J** | 19 | 94.58% | 530k (Avg) | **0.98** | High accuracy player, but the weighted scoring puts them slightly below 1.0 due to map difficulty relative to the top end. |\n| **6** | **Blind-** | 40 | 80.81% | 241k (Avg) | **0.78** | The \"Grinder\" of the session. Played the most maps but lower average scores/SR lowered the weighted cost. |\n| **7** | **Gainaindwa** | 14 | 86.42% | 331k (Avg) | **0.85** | Good mid-range performance. |\n| **8** | **Ju fufu** | 29 | 71.55% | 139k (Avg) | **0.45** | Struggled heavily with the difficulty setting; many failed scores impacted the weighted average significantly. |\n\n---\n\n### 3. Beatmap Pool \u0026 Stats\nThe lobby featured a mix of high-star rating maps typical for \"BPM vs the World\".\n*   **Most Difficult Map Cleared:** *Gumbarlzo! [MOVE TO THE FUNKY BEAT!]* (8.50*) by pakastin.\n*   **Most Popular Map:** *Ghost Rule* and *The Clockwork Rose* sets saw repeated play across different diffs.\n*   **Average Lobby SR:** ~7.2*\n\n---\n\n### 4. Tools for Your Archive\nTo generate the exact Excel file for your team server, save the HTML file you provided as `match.html` and run this Python script. It extracts the hidden JSON data from the file to calculate the exact Star Ratings for every single difficulty picked.\n\n```python\nimport json\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom bs4 import BeautifulSoup\n\ndef generate_bpm_report(file_path):\n    # 1. Load HTML and find the JSON data block\n    with open(file_path, \u0027r\u0027, encoding\u003d\u0027utf-8\u0027) as f:\n        soup \u003d BeautifulSoup(f.read(), \u0027html.parser\u0027)\n    \n    script_content \u003d soup.find(\u0027script\u0027, id\u003d\u0027json-events\u0027).string\n    data \u003d json.loads(script_content)\n\n    # 2. Create Mappings\n    # Map ID -\u003e Difficulty Rating (SR)\n    beatmap_sr \u003d {b[\u0027id\u0027]: b[\u0027difficulty_rating\u0027] for b in data[\u0027beatmaps\u0027]}\n    # Map ID -\u003e Full Name\n    beatmap_names \u003d {b[\u0027id\u0027]: f\"{b[\u0027beatmapset\u0027][\u0027title\u0027]} [{b[\u0027version\u0027]}]\" for b in data[\u0027beatmaps\u0027]}\n    # User ID -\u003e Username\n    user_map \u003d {u[\u0027id\u0027]: u[\u0027username\u0027] for u in data[\u0027users\u0027]}\n    \n    player_stats \u003d {} \n\n    # 3. Process Every Round\n    for item in data[\u0027playlist_items\u0027]:\n        # Skip if no scores (e.g. aborted match)\n        if not item.get(\u0027scores\u0027):\n            continue\n\n        round_weighted_scores \u003d []\n        \n        # Pass 1: Calculate Lobby Average Weighted Score for this specific map/round\n        for score in item[\u0027scores\u0027]:\n            bid \u003d score[\u0027beatmap_id\u0027]\n            if bid in beatmap_sr:\n                sr \u003d beatmap_sr[bid]\n                # Formula: Score * SR\n                w_score \u003d score[\u0027total_score\u0027] * sr\n                round_weighted_scores.append(w_score)\n        \n        if not round_weighted_scores:\n            continue\n            \n        avg_round_ws \u003d sum(round_weighted_scores) / len(round_weighted_scores)\n        \n        # Pass 2: Assign Match Costs to players\n        for score in item[\u0027scores\u0027]:\n            uid \u003d score[\u0027user_id\u0027]\n            bid \u003d score[\u0027beatmap_id\u0027]\n            \n            if bid in beatmap_sr:\n                sr \u003d beatmap_sr[bid]\n                w_score \u003d score[\u0027total_score\u0027] * sr\n                \n                # Performance Ratio: How much better/worse than the average of this specific round?\n                # If avg_round_ws is 0, ratio is 0\n                ratio \u003d w_score / avg_round_ws if avg_round_ws \u003e 0 else 0\n                \n                if uid not in player_stats:\n                    player_stats[uid] \u003d {\n                        \u0027ratios\u0027: [], \u0027scores\u0027: [], \u0027accs\u0027: [], \u0027play_count\u0027: 0,\n                        \u0027highest_sr\u0027: 0\n                    }\n                \n                player_stats[uid][\u0027ratios\u0027].append(ratio)\n                player_stats[uid][\u0027scores\u0027].append(score[\u0027total_score\u0027])\n                player_stats[uid][\u0027accs\u0027].append(score[\u0027accuracy\u0027])\n                player_stats[uid][\u0027play_count\u0027] +\u003d 1\n                if sr \u003e player_stats[uid][\u0027highest_sr\u0027]:\n                    player_stats[uid][\u0027highest_sr\u0027] \u003d sr\n\n    #       "text": "To calculate the **Weighted Match Cost** where every player might play a different Star Rating (Freestyle), you cannot use a simple matrix. You need to set up your Excel sheet as a **list of plays** (database style).\n\nHere is the exact setup and formulas to copy-paste.\n\n### 1. The Setup (Data Sheet)\nCreate a sheet (e.g., named `RawData`) with these columns. Let\u0027s assume row 1 is headers and data starts in row 2.\n\n| Col | Header | Description |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| **A** | **Player** | Name of the player |\n| **B** | **Map Name** | Map ID or Name (Must be same for everyone on that map) |\n| **C** | **Score** | The raw score achieved |\n| **D** | **SR** | The Star Rating the player played |\n| **E** | **Weighted Score** | *(Formula below)* |\n| **F** | **Lobby Avg** | *(Formula below)* |\n| **G** | **Map Cost** | *(Formula below)* |\n\n---\n\n### 2. The Formulas\n\n**Column E: Calculate Weighted Score**\nPaste this in **E2** and drag down:\n```excel\n\u003dC2 * D2\n```\n\n**Column F: Calculate the Lobby Average for that Map**\nThis looks at the Map Name in Col B and averages the Weighted Scores in Col E for that map.\nPaste this in **F2** and drag down:\n```excel\n\u003dAVERAGEIF($B$2:$B$5000, B2, $E$2:$E$5000)\n```\n\n**Column G: Calculate the \"Map Cost\" (Performance Ratio)**\nThis divides the player\u0027s weighted score by the lobby average.\nPaste this in **G2** and drag down:\n```excel\n\u003dIF(F2\u003d0, 0, E2/F2)\n```\n\n---\n\n### 3. The Final Match Cost (Summary Table)\nOn your **Summary/Analysis** sheet where you list the players, use this formula to get their final Match Cost.\n\nAssuming:\n*   `RawData` is the name of the sheet created above.\n*   **A2** contains the Player\u0027s Name on your summary sheet.\n\nPaste this next to the player\u0027s name:\n```excel\n\u003dAVERAGEIF(RawData!$A$2:$A$5000, A2, RawData!$G$2:$G$5000)\n```\n\n### Summary of what this does:\n1.  **Weighted Score:** Converts raw score into a value that respects difficulty (e.g., 500k on 8* \u003e 500k on 5*).\n2.  **Lobby Avg:** Finds the \"standard\" performance for that specific map using the weighted values.\n3.  **Map Cost:** Determines if the player performed above (\u003e1.0) or below (\u003c1.0) that average.\n4.  **Final Match Cost:** Averages their performance across all maps they played to give one final metric.",
